content.text: Jager the Belgian Malinois puppy. He has tan-coloured fur, which is black around his big eyes and nose. His ears are standing up but the tips have flopped down and are pointing at the floor. His head is poking out of a large police dog handler vest.
A spokesperson for the Environment Agency: 'We have investigated a fish kill incident at Locke Park and determined that it was caused by natural factors.'
